messages:
Alex: Preflight start — deploying release v2.14.0 to hosted and dedicated. Change window open 23:00-01:00 UTC. Please monitor SLO dash and call abort if thresholds breached. Key checks: p95 latency, 5xx rate, 429 per-model. :eyes:

 deploy-bot: Deploy initiated to canary pool (10% traffic). canary id=canary-2026-03-20-01

 Priya: Copy. What's the current sampling rate for detailed tracing on canary? We should raise sampling to 100% for 5m.

 Miguel: Observability: increased sampling enabled via:
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/sampling -d '{"rate":1.0,"scope":"canary-2026-03-20-01"}'
```
Applied.

 Samira: Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.net/d/84x/slo-deploy?orgId=1&from=now-15m&to=now
Look at p95 overall and per-region panels.

 Priya: Note: set alert thresholds for this window — p95 > 180ms sustained 5m OR 5xx rate >0.5% spike.

 Alex: Agreed. Add a short-lived alert rule with suppressions off so oncall gets page. oncall-bot, create alert.

 oncall-bot: Alert rule created: deploy-window:v2.14.0:p95>180ms:5m

 Miguel: eu-west instance reporting mem pressure on gpu-node-07, p95 creeping +40ms; not yet breach. Suggest pin traffic away from eu-west if p95 delta >25ms.

 Priya: I'll add routing override: set regional cap to 5% for eu-west canary.

 deploy-bot: Routing override applied: eu-west cap=5% for canary-2026-03-20-01

 Samira: Heads up, seeing small 429 bump on embed models from coalesced requests. It's transient but correlated with micro-burst in seq len. Watching.

 Alex: If 5xx or p95 breaches the rule for 5m, rollback decision criteria: auto-rollback if 2 out of 3 signals (p95, 5xx, 429) breach. Manual rollback allowed earlier. Keep notes in thread.

 Priya: Adding quick playbook snippet:
```
if p95>180ms for 5m OR 5xx_rate>0.5% for 5m:
  -> pause rollout
  -> scale down canary
  -> rollback to tag v2.13.8 if no improvement in 5m
```

 Miguel: Seeing 5xx spike at 00:12:24 UTC, routing anomalies. Putting temp pin to fallback model variant.

 deploy-bot: Traffic shifted: canary->fallback-model variant applied for embed-models

 Samira: 429 spike peaked, p95 stabilized after routing change. :thumbsup:

 Alex: Good catch. Let's keep sampling at 100% for another 10m and then revert. Make a note in release notes about model variant sensitivity to long sequences.

 Priya: Noted. I'll annotate the release with the incident and action taken.

 Alex: Closing window if stable for 30m. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
